docs.markdown:
# Threat model: Klarbefund, the iPhone app

The hub's threat model is [`threat-model.md`](/docs/security/threat-model-hub). This one is
for the app in [`clients/ios`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/tree/main/clients/ios), which runs on a person's phone, holds their
laboratory values and sends nothing anywhere unless they say so. Written
2026-10-15 against commit [`64737039`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/commit/64737039); each mitigation names the code or test
that shows it, and [`clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/SecurityPostureTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/SecurityPostureTests.swift)
pins the ones that are build settings. [STRIDE](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/develop/threat-modeling-tool-threats), as in the hub's model.

## System context

```
   paper report ──camera──▶ ┌──────────────────────────────┐
   lab PDF ──files/share──▶ │ Klarbefund (iOS 26, Swift 6)  │
   Apple Health ──read───▶ │  OCR · coding · AES-GCM store │
                           └──────┬──────────┬────────────┘
                 optional, consent│          │optional, consent
                                  ▼          ▼
                 ┌──────────────────┐   ┌─────────────────────────┐
                 │ EHDS hub         │   │ explanation service      │
                 │ (ADR-049/054/057)│   │ on device by default;    │
                 │ OIDC+PKCE, App   │   │ hosted: Azure OpenAI EU  │
                 │ Attest, Bearer   │   │ data zone, or own key    │
                 └──────────────────┘   └─────────────────────────┘
```

The hub connection is the device grant ([ADR-049](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-049-klarbefund-connects-by-device-grant.md)), the sandbox account with App Attest ([ADR-054](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-054-klarbefund-creates-a-sandbox-account-with-app-attest.md)) and the weekly means ([ADR-057](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-057-klarbefund-sends-weekly-device-means.md)), signed in with [OpenID Connect](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html) and [PKCE S256](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7636#section-4.2); [App Attest](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicecheck/establishing-your-app-s-integrity) proves the app. The hosted explanation runs on Azure OpenAI in the [EU data zone](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-foundry/openai/how-to/deployment-types#data-zone-standard).

Trust boundaries: the device (Secure Enclave, [data protection](https://support.apple.com/guide/security/data-protection-overview-secf6276da8a/web), app sandbox)
is trusted as Apple provides it. Everything that leaves the device crosses a
boundary and does so only after a consent the person gave for that purpose.

## Assets

| Asset                                   | Where                                                                                                                                     | Why it matters                                                                     |
| --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Laboratory values, reports, page images | the store, [`ReportStore.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/ReportStore.swift)                                                  | [Art. 9 GDPR](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_9) health data |
| The store key                           | Keychain, [`WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/ksecattraccessiblewhenunlockedthisdeviceonly) | decrypts everything above                                                          |
| Hub tokens (device grant, app token)    | Keychain, `ThisDeviceOnly`, [`EHDSConnection`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/EHDSConnection.swift)                                 | write access to the person's own hub record                                        |
| App Attest key                          | Secure Enclave, [`DeviceCheck`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicecheck/establishing-your-app-s-integrity)                  | proves a genuine app to the hub when creating accounts                             |
| Consents and their history              | [`Consents.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/Consents.swift)                                                                       | the legal basis for every transfer                                                 |
| Diagnostics export                      | written on request only, [ADR-038](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-038-scan-retained-diagnostics-export.md)                                                   | contains values; must never enter the repository                                   |

## STRIDE

### Spoofing

| Threat                                                    | Mitigation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Status |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| A fake app creates hub accounts or pushes data as the app | Account creation needs an Apple App Attest attestation the hub verifies ([ADR-054](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-054-klarbefund-creates-a-sandbox-account-with-app-attest.md)); every later call carries the app token                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | met    |
| A fake hub harvests tokens                                | OIDC discovery from the configured issuer only, [PKCE S256](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7636#section-4.2), [`ASWebAuthenticationSession`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/authenticationservices/aswebauthenticationsession); [ATS](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/preventing-insecure-network-connections) forbids plaintext ([`OIDCSession.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/OIDCSession.swift)) | met    |
| A fake explanation service reads values                   | The provider is named in the request the person approves ([`CloudConsentSheet.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/CloudConsentSheet.swift)); HTTPS by [ATS](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/preventing-insecure-network-connections)                                                                                                                                                                                  | met    |
| Someone else at the unlocked phone                        | App lock: Face ID, Touch ID or the passcode before the cover lifts, on by default ([`AppLock.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/AppLock.swift), [ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md))                                                                                                                                                                                   | met    |

### Tampering

| Threat                                         | Mitigation                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Status   |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- |
| Stored records altered on disk or over a cable | Each record AES-GCM sealed (authenticated), key in the Keychain; a cable test could not copy stored data                                                                                                           | met      |
| A misread value treated as a laboratory result | Provenance keeps OCR values `preliminary`; only a laboratory's own PDF text layer yields `final` ([`Provenance.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/Provenance.swift))                                         | met      |
| A tampered build                               | App Attest proves the app to the hub, not to itself; jailbreak and debugger detection declined with reasons ([ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md)) | accepted |
| A dependency with a backdoor                   | No third-party package at all ([`Package.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Package.swift), [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/project.yml), [`docs/sbom/klarbefund-ios.cdx.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/sbom/klarbefund-ios.cdx.json))         | met      |

### Repudiation

| Threat                                | Mitigation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Status |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| "I never consented to that transfer"  | Consent events with time, holder and effective date, revocable, with history ([`Consents.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/Consents.swift))                                                                                                                  | met    |
| What was sent cannot be reconstructed | A sync is a [FHIR Bundle](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/bundle.html) with a SHA-256 fingerprint the app records ([`EHDSConnection.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/EHDSConnection.swift), [ADR-057](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-057-klarbefund-sends-weekly-device-means.md)) | met    |

### Information disclosure

| Threat                                     | Mitigation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Status   |
| ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| Values leave the device without the person | On-device OCR, coding, analysis and export; the only network calls are the two optional ones above, each behind its own consent                                                                                                                                                                          | met      |
| Backups or iCloud carry the store          | [Store excluded from backup](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/urlresourcevalues/isexcludedfrombackup); [`NSFileProtectionComplete`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/nsfileprotectioncomplete) default; exports and diagnostics written with complete protection | met      |
| The app switcher shows values              | [`PrivacyCover.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/PrivacyCover.swift) covers the window when the app is not active                                                                                                                                                                             | met      |
| Logs carry values                          | Log lines carry counts and codes only ([`Logging.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/Logging.swift))                                                                                                                                                                                                | met      |
| A cloud question identifies the person     | At most 40 values, no name, date of birth or insurance number; the service enforces the same ([`CloudAnalysis.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/CloudAnalysis.swift), [ADR-034](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-034-claude-workload-identity-federation.md))                                                          | met      |
| Transfer to a third country                | Default on device; hosted default Azure OpenAI in the [EU data zone](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-foundry/openai/how-to/deployment-types#data-zone-standard); the Anthropic option is opt-in and says "United States"                                                                      | partly   |
| Screenshots or screen recording            | Not prevented (iOS allows no reliable block)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | accepted |

### Denial of service

| Threat                           | Mitigation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Status   |
| -------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| The hub is down                  | The app works without the hub; the record is on the device                                                                                                                                                                                                            | met      |
| A hostile scan floods the parser | Vision and the parser run on bounded images; a degraded scan loses rows, never hangs ([`ScanningTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/ScanningTests.swift), [`AccuracyBenchmarkTests`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/AccuracyBenchmarkTests.swift)) | met      |
| Lost phone                       | Export in four formats for the person to keep; no recovery from the hub by design                                                                                                                                                                                     | accepted |

### Elevation of privilege

| Threat                                  | Mitigation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Status |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------ |
| Debug entry points in a release build   | `-MBSelfTest`, `-MBDemoSeed`, `-MBShot` are compiled out (`#if DEBUG`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | met    |
| The app writes to Apple Health          | [Read-only authorisation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/healthkit/protecting-user-privacy) ([`WearableSource.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/WearableSource.swift)); pinned by [`SecurityPostureTests`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/SecurityPostureTests.swift) | met    |
| The app token does more than the record | The hub scopes the token to the sandbox record of that account; `isSandboxUsername` on every app route                                                                                                                                                                                           | met    |

## Residual risks and what closes them

1. **App lock**: decided and implemented 2026-10-15 ([ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md)). ([TR-03161](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/Publications/TechGuidelines/TR03161/TR-03161-1.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=2) O.Auth)
2. **No tamper or jailbreak detection**: declined with reasons in [ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md); the sealed store and App Attest are the controls. (O.Resi)
3. **No certificate pinning**: declined with reasons in [ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md); ATS without an exception domain, managed rotation. (O.Ntwk)
4. **Hosted Anthropic option.** Opt-in, named on screen, but a transfer to the
   United States; the operator needs a transfer basis or must switch it off.
5. **Independent test.** This model and the tests are the project's own. An
   independent penetration test against a release build on a device, and the
   requirement-level TR-03161 gap list, remain open; see
   [`security-test-report-2026-10-15.md`](/docs/security/security-test-report).

docs.markdown:
# Klarbefund: self-assessment

Data protection, security and regulatory status of the Klarbefund iPhone app,
assessed by the project itself against the code in [`clients/ios/`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/tree/main/clients/ios) as of
2026-10-15. **This is a self-assessment, not a certification, an audit or a
legal opinion.** Every "met" below points to the code or test that shows it;
anything not shown is marked open. Accuracy evidence is in
[`evidence.md`](/docs/security/klarbefund-evidence); running it on a Mac in [`run-on-mac.md`](/docs/security/klarbefund-run-on-mac).
The code references below were last checked against the sources on 2026-10-15,
the same day the evidence was last produced (see the run record in
[`evidence.md`](/docs/security/klarbefund-evidence#run-record)).

Status values: **met** (implemented and shown in code or tests), **partly**
(implemented in part, or shown only by design), **open** (not done), **n/a**
(does not apply to this app).

## Scope

| In scope                                                                                                                                                                                       | Out of scope                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| The iOS app ([`clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/tree/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund), [`Sources/Shared`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/tree/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared)), release build                                  | The demo hub and its Azure deployment, assessed separately ([ADR-045](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-045-observability-and-regulatory-audit-trail.md), the [BSI C5 gap analysis](/docs/security/bsi-c5-gap-analysis))                            |
| Its optional calls to the hub (EHDS connect, [ADR-049](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-049-klarbefund-connects-by-device-grant.md)/[054](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-054-klarbefund-creates-a-sandbox-account-with-app-attest.md)) | Apple's platform (iOS, [Secure Enclave](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/protecting-keys-with-the-secure-enclave), [HealthKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/healthkit)), relied on as provided |
| Its optional call to the cloud explanation service ([ADR-034](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-034-claude-workload-identity-federation.md))                                                                         | The model providers behind that service                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## Data protection (GDPR)

The data processed is health data, a special category under [Art. 9 GDPR](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_9).

| Principle                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Status | How the app meets it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Where                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Data protection by default ([Art. 25](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_25))                                                                                                                                             | met    | No account. Scanning, OCR, coding, storage and export run on the device; nothing leaves it unless the person sends it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | [`Scanning.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/Scanning.swift), [`ReportStore.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/ReportStore.swift), [`OnDeviceAnalysis.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/OnDeviceAnalysis.swift)                                                                                        |
| Data minimisation ([Art. 5(1)(c)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#005.001))                                                                                                                                                | met    | The store holds no name, birth date or insurance number. A cloud question carries only the values the person ticks, at most 40, and no identifying field; the service enforces this again server-side.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | [`Sources/Shared/CloudAnalysis.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/CloudAnalysis.swift), [`CloudAnalysisContractTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/CloudAnalysisContractTests.swift), [ADR-034](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-034-claude-workload-identity-federation.md)                                                            |
| Purpose limitation and consent ([Art. 6](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_6), [9(2)(a)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#009.002))                                                                     | met    | Study participation, ePA objection and registry/research use are separate consents, each revocable. A cloud call names its provider in the request itself, so a blanket setting cannot stand in for it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | [`Sources/Shared/Consents.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/Consents.swift), [`ConsentsTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/ConsentsTests.swift), [`CloudConsentSheet.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/CloudConsentSheet.swift)                                                                        |
| Rights of access, portability, erasure ([Art. 15](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_15), [17](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_17), [20](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_20)) | met    | Full export (JSON, FHIR R4, OMOP CDM, PDF) and full deletion from the app; an EHDS hub account the app created can be deleted by it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | [`DataExport.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/DataExport.swift), [`ReportExport.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/ReportExport.swift), [`OmopExportTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/OmopExportTests.swift), [ADR-054](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-054-klarbefund-creates-a-sandbox-account-with-app-attest.md) |
| Security of processing ([Art. 32](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_32))                                                                                                                                                 | met    | See the security section.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Transparency ([Art. 13](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_13))                                                                                                                                                           | partly | Permission texts in English and German, privacy manifest declares health data, not linked, not tracked. A full privacy notice for an operator is not part of the repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/project.yml) (usage strings), [`PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy), [`LegalViews.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/LegalViews.swift)                                                                                                     |
| Transfer to third countries ([Art. 44](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_44) ff.)                                                                                                                                        | partly | Default is on device: nothing is transferred. The person can switch at any time to the hosted service, whose default is Azure OpenAI in the EU data zone ([`DataZoneStandard`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-foundry/openai/how-to/deployment-types#data-zone-standard), no transfer), or to their own Azure OpenAI resource or their own Anthropic key. Only Anthropic, hosted or own key, processes in the United States; the app says so on the settings screen. For the hosted Anthropic option the operator needs a processor agreement and a transfer basis. | [`ProviderSettings.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/ProviderSettings.swift), [`services/claude-federation/src/providers.ts`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/services/claude-federation/src/providers.ts), [ADR-034](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-034-claude-workload-identity-federation.md)                                                                         |
| Records of processing, DPIA ([Art. 30](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_30), [35](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_35))                                                                            | open   | No record of processing and no DPIA. A DPIA is likely required for any operator (health data, new technology). The project can supply a template; the operator owns it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Controller role                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | open   | Using the app on one's own device is personal use. Whoever runs the cloud explanation service or a hub the app connects to is a controller or processor and must be named.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## Security: BSI TR-03161 part 1 (mobile applications)

Assessed at the level of the test objective groups of
[TR-03161 part 1, version 3.0](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/Publications/TechGuidelines/TR03161/TR-03161-1.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=2).
A certification maps each individual requirement against the official PDF and
is carried out by a BSI-recognised test laboratory; this table is the input to
that gap analysis, not a replacement for it.

| Group                         | Status | Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Gap                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| O.Purp: purpose, minimisation | met    | Purpose stated in the app and the [user guide](/docs/klarbefund/klarbefund-user-guide#not-a-medical-device) ("Not a medical device"); minimisation and per-call consent as above; no tracking ([`NSPrivacyTracking`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/privacy-manifest-files) false).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Formal intended-purpose statement (see regulation).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| O.Arch: architecture          | met    | On-device by default; the phone holds no API credential ([ADR-034](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-034-claude-workload-identity-federation.md)); hub accounts only from an [App Attest](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicecheck/establishing-your-app-s-integrity)-verified app ([ADR-054](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-054-klarbefund-creates-a-sandbox-account-with-app-attest.md)); provenance model keeps OCR values `preliminary` ([`Provenance.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/Provenance.swift)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Threat model written: [`docs/security/threat-model-klarbefund.md`](/docs/security/threat-model-klarbefund).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| O.Source: source code         | partly | CodeQL on every iOS change ([`codeql-swift.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql-swift.yml), [`Scripts/codeql-swift.sh`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Scripts/codeql-swift.sh); 0 findings on 2026-10-15); debug-only launch arguments compiled out of release builds (`#if DEBUG`); Swift 6 strict concurrency; [`SecurityPostureTests`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/SecurityPostureTests.swift) pin the build settings this table cites.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | No obfuscation (open source by design; argue as not applicable).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| O.TrdP: third-party software  | met    | No third-party package at all: [`Package.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Package.swift) and [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/project.yml) declare no external dependency; only Apple frameworks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | SBOM: [`docs/sbom/klarbefund-ios.cdx.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/sbom/klarbefund-ios.cdx.json), regenerated by [`scripts/security/generate-sbom.sh`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/scripts/security/generate-sbom.sh) `--check`.                                                                                                                                                      |
| O.Cryp: cryptography          | met    | Only Apple CryptoKit: each record sealed with [AES-GCM](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/cryptokit/aes/gcm) under a 256-bit key; key in the Keychain as [`WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/ksecattraccessiblewhenunlockedthisdeviceonly); no own cryptography ([`ReportStore.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/ReportStore.swift#L65-L71), export-compliance note in [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/project.yml)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| O.Rand: random numbers        | met    | Keys from [`SymmetricKey(size: .bits256)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/cryptokit/symmetrickey), Apple's system RNG.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| O.Auth: authentication        | met    | No local account. Hub: [OIDC](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html) with [PKCE](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7636#section-4.2) in [`ASWebAuthenticationSession`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/authenticationservices/aswebauthenticationsession) ([`OIDCSession.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/OIDCSession.swift)), device grant with Keycloak consent ([ADR-049](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-049-klarbefund-connects-by-device-grant.md)), App Attest ([ADR-054](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-054-klarbefund-creates-a-sandbox-account-with-app-attest.md)); tokens in the Keychain, [`ThisDeviceOnly`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/ksecattraccessiblewhenunlockedthisdeviceonly) ([`EHDSConnection.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/EHDSConnection.swift)). | App lock since 2026-10-15: Face ID or Touch ID, passcode as fallback, on by default ([`AppLock.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/AppLock.swift), [`AppLockPolicy`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/AppLockPolicy.swift), [ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md)). |
| O.Pass: passwords             | n/a    | The app handles no passwords; sign-in happens in the system web session.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| O.Data: data at rest          | met    | [`NSFileProtectionComplete`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/nsfileprotectioncomplete) as the default data protection (entitlement); records AES-GCM sealed; store excluded from backup; exports and diagnostics written with complete protection; app switcher covered ([`PrivacyCover.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/PrivacyCover.swift)); log lines carry counts and codes only. A cable test failed to copy stored data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Independent verification of the cable test.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| O.Paid: paid resources        | n/a    | No in-app purchases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| O.Ntwk: network               | partly | [App Transport Security](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/preventing-insecure-network-connections) on, exception only for local networking ([`project.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/project.yml)); all hub and service calls over HTTPS.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | No certificate pinning, declined with reasons in [ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md) (ATS, no exception domain, managed rotation).                                                                                                                                         |
| O.Resi: resilience            | open   | App Attest proves app integrity to the hub, not to the app itself.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | No jailbreak or debugger detection, declined with reasons in [ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md) (bypassable; the sealed store and App Attest are the controls).                                                                                                           |
| O.Plat: platform              | met    | Camera and HealthKit asked for at the moment of use, HealthKit read-only with no copy kept; no notifications; app switcher covered.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

Backend parts ([TR-03161 part 3](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/Publications/TechGuidelines/TR03161/TR-03161-3.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=4)) apply to the cloud explanation service and the
hub, not to the app, and are out of scope here. TR-03161 certification is
mandatory for a DiGA ([§ 139e(10) SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__139e.html)); Klarbefund is not one (see below).

## Regulation

| Framework                                                                                                                                               | Assessment                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Status                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| Medical device ([MDR 2017/745](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/745/oj/eng) / [IVDR 2017/746](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/746/oj/eng)) | Intended purpose as stated: store, display and export the values a laboratory printed, and explain what a measurement is. No diagnosis, risk assessment, prognosis or treatment advice; no normal/abnormal verdict. Under [MDCG 2019-11](https://health.ec.europa.eu/document/download/b45335c5-1679-4c71-a91c-fc7a4d37f12b_en) Rev.1 (section 3.1, decision step 3), software that performs no action on data beyond storage, archival, communication, simple search or lossless compression is not medical device software. Display is not in that list; the project's position is that showing the printed values unchanged is not such an action. Because the values come from in-vitro samples, the IVDR, not [MDR rule 11](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/745/oj/eng#anx_VIII), would apply if it qualified ([ADR-034](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-034-claude-workload-identity-federation.md)). **Borderline:** the trends screen colours values against published bands ([ADR-039](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-039-published-reference-ranges.md)). The project's position is that a comparison with a quoted, sourced number is not a finding. | partly: written qualification and an external opinion open |
| DiGA ([§ 139e SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__139e.html))                                                                             | Not applicable: a DiGA must be a CE-marked medical device ([§ 33a SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__33a.html)), and Klarbefund is deliberately not one. Consequently no DiGA-specific certificates (ISO 27001, ISO 13485, TR-03161) are claimed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | n/a                                                        |
| EU AI Act ([2024/1689](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj/eng))                                                                             | The optional explanation feature uses a language model, on device by default or a named cloud provider. As long as the app is not a medical device it is not a high-risk system under [Art. 6(1)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj/eng#art_6). Transparency: the answer must be recognisable as AI-generated ([Art. 50](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj/eng#art_50)). A hosted answer ends with "Answered by <provider>, model <model>" ([`CloudConsentSheet.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/CloudConsentSheet.swift)); the on-device answer says "Answered by on-device, model Apple on-device model" through the same footer ([`OnDeviceAnalysis.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/MeinBefund/OnDeviceAnalysis.swift)); [`SecurityPostureTests`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/SecurityPostureTests.swift) pins both.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | met: every answer names provider and model                 |
| EHDS ([2025/327](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng))                                                                                    | Primary use: the app reads the person's own record from the hub with consent ([ADR-049](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-049-klarbefund-connects-by-device-grant.md)). If the app is ever offered as claiming interoperability with EHR systems, it becomes a wellness application under [Art. 47](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng#art_47) and needs the label described there.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | n/a today                                                  |
| Apple distribution                                                                                                                                      | [TestFlight](https://developer.apple.com/testflight/) build approved by [Apple's beta review for external testers](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/test-a-beta-version/invite-external-testers) ([ADR-050](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-050-klarbefund-beta-by-public-testflight-link.md)); privacy manifest and App Privacy label declare health data, not linked, not tracked.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | met                                                        |

## What would close the open items

Done on 2026-10-15, by the project itself (see
[`docs/security/security-test-report-2026-10-15.md`](/docs/security/security-test-report)):
the threat model, the SBOM, a configuration test suite, and a self-conducted
security test with CodeQL, Semgrep, grype, trivy, gitleaks and anonymous
black-box checks of the hub. Still open:

1. Written intended-purpose statement and [MDCG 2019-11](https://health.ec.europa.eu/document/download/b45335c5-1679-4c71-a91c-fc7a4d37f12b_en) qualification, with an
   external opinion on the trends colouring.
2. Hosted explanation service: name the operator as controller or processor,
   sign the processor agreement with Azure (EU data zone, the default), and for
   the opt-in Anthropic option document the transfer basis or switch it off.
3. DPIA template and data-flow diagram for an operator.
4. An **independent** penetration test (a release build on a device, the
   hub as each role in office hours), and the requirement-level TR-03161
   part 1 gap list against the official PDF. The self-conducted test says
   what such a test would add.
5. Done 2026-10-15 ([ADR-060](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-060-the-app-locks-with-face-id-and-answers-pinning-and-jailbreak-detection.md)): the app lock is implemented, on by default;
   certificate pinning and jailbreak detection are declined with written
   reasons. Remaining for a laboratory: judge those reasons.

docs.markdown:
# Klarbefund: evidence

What a reviewer outside this project can check about Klarbefund, the iPhone
lab-report scanner ([#186](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/issues/186)),
and what is still missing. Written for an insurer's, a hospital's or an
auditor's first question: _is the extraction right, is the data safe, and is
this a medical device?_ Data protection, [BSI TR-03161](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/Publications/TechGuidelines/TR03161/TR-03161-1.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=2) and regulation are
assessed in [`self-assessment.md`](/docs/security/klarbefund-self-assessment); how to run all of this
on a Mac is in [`run-on-mac.md`](/docs/security/klarbefund-run-on-mac). The person-facing description is in
[`user-guide.md`](/docs/klarbefund/klarbefund-user-guide), the developer side in
[`clients/ios/README.md`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/README.md).

Klarbefund is open source under the [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/LICENSE). The
project is not a vendor: there is no company behind it, no support contract and
no warranty. Whoever deploys the app, or a fork of it, operates it and carries
the data protection and security duties that come with that.

## Status

- At the [HL7 AI Challenge 2026](https://blog.hl7.org/how-the-2026-hl7-ai-challenge-is-helping-shape-the-future-of-responsible-ai-in-healthcare) submission (deadline 2026-06-30) Klarbefund
  was a prototype. The award ("Open Solution") went to the EHDS platform in
  this repository.
- In the winner presentation the app was shown as a live demo.
- It is in TestFlight, approved by Apple's beta review for external testers
  ([ADR-050](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-050-klarbefund-beta-by-public-testflight-link.md)).
- It reads Apple Health ([HealthKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/healthkit), read only) and connects to the demo hub,
  whose secondary use runs in the hub's Secure Processing Environment
  ([ADR-037](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-037-secure-processing-environment-confidential-computing.md), [ADR-068](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-068-a-sovereign-confidential-spe-on-confidential-containers-and-trustee.md), [ADR-069](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-069-two-spe-workspaces-as-aci-confidential-containers.md)).

## What is already evidenced

| Claim                                                        | Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A degraded scan loses rows, it never invents values          | [`Tests/SharedTests/ScanningTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/ScanningTests.swift): synthetic sheets under skew, glare, dim light, blur and low resolution, read with Vision; any coded value not on the sheet fails                                                                                                                              |
| German number rules (decimal comma, `1.240` = 1240, `0.300`) | [`Tests/SharedTests/LabLineParserTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/LabLineParserTests.swift)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| The unit selects the LOINC code; urine is never serum        | [`LabLineParserTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/LabLineParserTests.swift), [`RealScanLessonsTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/RealScanLessonsTests.swift) (layouts of 19 real scans, every value invented)                                                                                                                       |
| Nothing is dropped silently                                  | Self-test ([`-MBSelfTest`](/docs/klarbefund/klarbefund-developer-guide#the-self-test), 27 checks): every printed row ends up coded, unmapped or unread                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| OCR values stay preliminary                                  | Provenance model ([`Sources/Shared/Provenance.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/Provenance.swift)): only a laboratory's own PDF text layer yields [FHIR `final`](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/valueset-observation-status.html)                                                                                                                                 |
| A real scan can be replayed without the phone or the image   | [`swift run ScanReplay`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/tree/main/clients/ios/Tools/ScanReplay), [`swift run LabFile`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/tree/main/clients/ios/Tools/LabFile); both refuse paths inside this repository                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Exports are standard                                         | [FHIR R4](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/bundle.html) bundle with LOINC and [UCUM](https://ucum.org/ucum) ([`FhirBundleParityTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/FhirBundleParityTests.swift)), [OMOP CDM v5.4](https://ohdsi.github.io/CommonDataModel/cdm54.html) ([`OmopExportTests.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/OmopExportTests.swift)) |
| Data stays on the device by default                          | On-device OCR and analysis, per-item encryption, no iCloud backup, separate consents, export and deletion ([`user-guide.md`](/docs/klarbefund/klarbefund-user-guide#privacy-and-safety))                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

## Measuring accuracy

`ExtractionAccuracy` ([`clients/ios/Sources/Shared/ExtractionAccuracy.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Sources/Shared/ExtractionAccuracy.swift))
compares an extraction with a hand-checked truth, field by field: value with
its comparator, unit, LOINC code (or the expected refusal), printed reference
range and laboratory date. Its headline numbers:

- **exact**: rows right in every checked field;
- **silent errors**: rows that were coded, so shown as a value, and wrong in
  value, unit or code. This is the number that matters clinically; the target
  is zero;
- **spurious**: coded values with no row on the sheet behind them;
- **missed** and **unread**: rows lost, and lines handed to the reviewer.

Two ways to run it:

1. **Synthetic benchmark, in CI.** [`AccuracyBenchmarkTests`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Tests/SharedTests/AccuracyBenchmarkTests.swift) renders the
   synthetic panel under nine scan conditions, reads it with Vision and asserts
   zero silent errors under each. Locally: `cd clients/ios && swift test`; with
   `KLARBEFUND_BENCHMARK_OUT=<file>` set, the counts are written there as JSON.
   An `ios-unit-tests` job for [`.github/workflows/test.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml) (pending, YAML in
   [`run-on-mac.md`](/docs/security/klarbefund-run-on-mac#4-put-the-swift-suite-into-ci)) runs the
   whole Swift suite on `macos-26` and keeps that JSON as the
   `klarbefund-accuracy-benchmark` artifact; until it lands, CI builds only the
   `Shared` target. No real data is involved, so the JSON can be published as
   it is.
2. **Pilot on real reports, never in the repository.** A participant exports
   diagnostics from the app ([ADR-038](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-038-scan-retained-diagnostics-export.md)), and a `truth.json` is written beside each
   `diagnostics.json` from the paper:

   ```json
   {
     "schema": 1,
     "labDate": "2026-09-12",
     "rows": [
       {
         "label": "LDL-Cholesterin",
         "value": 141,
         "unit": "mg/dl",
         "loinc": "2089-1",
         "referenceText": "< 116"
       },
       {
         "label": "Ferritin",
         "value": 10,
         "comparator": "<",
         "unit": "ug/l",
         "loinc": "2276-4"
       },
       {
         "label": "Natrium [U]",
         "value": 80,
         "unit": "mmol/l",
         "loinc": null,
         "refused": true
       }
     ]
   }
   ```

   ```bash
   cd clients/ios
   swift run ScanReplay ~/Pilot/export --truth          # per row: which fields were wrong, no values
   swift run ScanReplay ~/Pilot/export --truth --json   # counts only, the part to publish
   ```

   Only the counts leave the participant's folder. Before a report is used:
   written consent from the participant (purpose, retention, withdrawal, and
   whether values go to an explanation service), and a check that the study the
   report comes from does not restrict sharing its results.

Target values per field are fixed before a pilot is measured, and the pilot's
sample size is stated next to every number.

## Run record

The checklist in [`run-on-mac.md`](/docs/security/klarbefund-run-on-mac) was last run on 2026-10-15 at
commit [`1474295d`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/commit/1474295d) of the branch `feat/186-klarbefund-accuracy-evidence`, on macOS 26.7.1 with Xcode 26 (Swift 6.4).
