| [SSO-01](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=97) to [SSO-05](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=101) | Policies and instructions for controlling and monitoring third parties; Risk assessment of service providers and suppliers; Directory of service providers and suppliers; Monitoring of compliance with requirements; Exit strategy for the receipt of benefits | ⚠️          | Neo4j, Keycloak, the EDC components, Azure and the model providers are not formally assessed; the [bills of materials](/docs/security/sbom) list the software components |

### SIM: Security Incident Management

| Criterion                                                                                                                                                     | Catalogue title                                   | Demo Status | Where the hub stands                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [SIM-01](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=102) | Policy for security incident management           | 🟡          | The clocks and who notifies whom are in the [operational guideline, section 7](/docs/operations/operational-guideline#7-incidents-clocks-and-who-notifies-whom); no procedure with named contacts and no classification |
| [SIM-03](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=103) | Documentation and reporting of security incidents | ⚠️          | Not set up; a personal data breach goes to the supervisory authority within 72 hours ([GDPR Art. 33](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_33))                                           |

### PSS: Product Safety and Security

| Criterion                                                                                                                                                     | Catalogue title                                        | Demo Status | Where the hub stands                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [PSS-02](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=114) | Identification of Vulnerabilities of the Cloud Service | ✅          | Static analysis: CodeQL on every pull request and push to main that changes code ([`codeql.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml#L20-L35)) and for the app ([`codeql-swift.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql-swift.yml)); Semgrep with the repository's rules in pre-commit ([hook](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L149-L153)), not in CI; gitleaks in pre-commit, on each pull request's commits and nightly over the whole history ([hook](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L134-L137), [PR Gate](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml#L117-L124), [nightly](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.github/workflows/nightly.yml#L326-L331)); the anonymous black-box checks ([test report](/docs/security/security-test-report#method)) |
| [PSS-04](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=116) | Error handling and Logging Mechanisms                  | 🟡          | A patient sees who read their record on their own page; access body and holder read the audit trail; no export interface for a customer's SIEM                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [PSS-05](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=116) | Authentication Mechanisms                              | 🟡          | Every API route needs a session, `requireAuth()` in each handler, pinned by [`every-route-needs-a-session.test.ts`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/ui/__tests__/unit/api/every-route-needs-a-session.test.ts) ([ADR-044](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-044-every-api-route-needs-a-session.md)); sign-in through Keycloak OIDC; no second factor on offer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [PSS-06](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=117) | Session Management                                     | ✅          | NextAuth JWT session signed with `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` from Key Vault ([ADR-036](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-036-operator-secrets-in-key-vault.md)); `HttpOnly` cookie                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [PSS-08](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=118) | Roles and Rights Concept                               | ✅          | Seven Keycloak roles, the [role matrix](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.claude/rules/api-conventions.md#roles-and-access-control); who sees a patient's identity is decided by role ([`patient-identity.ts`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/ui/src/lib/patient-identity.ts#L33))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [PSS-09](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/CloudComputing/ComplianceControlsCatalogue/2020/C5_2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=5#page=119) | Authorisation Mechanisms                               | ✅          | `requireAuth()` with the roles a route admits, 403 otherwise; [`refuseForeignRecord()`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/ui/src/lib/patient/own-record.ts#L19) answers 403 for another patient's record                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

### Code-level measures with no criterion of their own

C5:2020 asks for a secure development policy (DEV-01) and for vulnerability identification including static analysis (PSS-02); it has no criterion for the following measures, which are the hub's evidence for both:

| Measure                              | Demo Status | Where the hub stands                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Parameterised queries                | ✅          | Parameterised Cypher, never string-interpolated ([`api-conventions.md`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.claude/rules/api-conventions.md#query-patterns))                                |
| Output encoding and a content policy | ✅          | React escapes output; a per-request nonce CSP with `strict-dynamic` ([`middleware.ts`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/ui/src/middleware.ts#L88-L95))                                    |
| No credentials in the code           | ✅          | Environment variables and Key Vault references ([ADR-036](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-036-operator-secrets-in-key-vault.md)); gitleaks as under PSS-02                         |
| Data minimisation                    | ✅          | FHIR routes return the requested fields only; a GDPR principle ([Art. 5(1)(c)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#005.001)), not a C5 criterion |

---

## Priority Gap Closure Plan

### Demo Phase

The demo-hardening items of [#4](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/issues/4) (closed):

| Priority | Criterion | Action                                   | State                                                                                                                  |
| -------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P0       | DEV-01    | Parameterised Cypher (D1)                | ✅ Done, Phase 23                                                                                                      |
| P0       | DEV-01    | CSP and security headers (D2)            | ✅ Done, Phase 23                                                                                                      |
| P0       | DEV-06    | Security E2E tests (D3)                  | ✅ Done, Phase 23                                                                                                      |
| P0       | OPS-22    | npm audit in CI (D4)                     | ✅ Done, Phase 23; now a pre-push hook                                                                                 |
| P1       | PSS-02    | Secret scanning in pre-commit (D5)       | ✅ Done: gitleaks in pre-commit, PR Gate and nightly                                                                   |
| P1       | OPS-18    | SECURITY.md and a disclosure policy (D8) | 🟡 The file exists; its text is still GitHub's template                                                                |
| P1       | PSS-05    | Verify all API routes check auth         | ✅ Done, Phase 24 (pentest D6); pinned per handler since [ADR-044](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-044-every-api-route-needs-a-session.md) |

### Production Roadmap

| Priority | Criterion        | Action                                                                                                                                       |
| -------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P0       | CRY-02           | TLS profile per TR-02102-2 pinned with the cloud; certificate rotation (HSTS is set)                                                         |
| P0       | IDM-09, PSS-05   | MFA for `EDC_ADMIN` and `HDAB_AUTHORITY`                                                                                                     |
| P0       | CRY-03           | Customer-managed keys for the graph and the database                                                                                         |
| P0       | OPS-06 to OPS-09 | Backups of the graph and a restore drill                                                                                                     |
| P1       | OPS-10           | SIEM integration (OpenSearch or Loki)                                                                                                        |
| P1       | OPS-13           | Alerting on failed authentication and unusual access                                                                                         |
| P1       | OPS-18           | Fill in `SECURITY.md` with a reporting address and response times                                                                            |
| P2       | SIM-01           | Incident response runbook with named contacts                                                                                                |
| P2       | OPS-14           | Write-once storage for the audit trail, on top of the hash chain                                                                             |
| P2       | IDM-01           | Attribute-based access control via OPA policies                                                                                              |
| P2       | DSP              | Signed contract messages ([DSP 2025-1](https://eclipse-dataspace-protocol-base.github.io/DataspaceProtocol/2025-1/))                         |
| P2       | DCP              | Credential signature, expiry and revocation checks ([DCP v1.0](https://eclipse-dataspace-dcp.github.io/decentralized-claims-protocol/v1.0/)) |

Done since the version of 2026-03-28: static analysis in CI (CodeQL; Semgrep runs in pre-commit only) and gitleaks in CI and pre-commit, as under PSS-02.

---

## EHDS and GDPR mapping

Article numbers are those of the adopted [Regulation (EU) 2025/327](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng); the 2026-03-28 version used proposal numbers ([numbering](/docs/ehds/article-numbering)).

| Article                                                                  | Requirement                                                             | C5 criteria                      | Demo Status                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Art. 3](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng#art_3)        | Patient's right of access to their own data                             | PSS-05, PSS-09                   | ✅ `/patient/*` routes; a patient sees only their own record                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [Art. 68](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng#art_68)      | Data permit, issued by the access body                                  | PSS-08, PSS-09                   | ✅ `HDABApproval` nodes                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [Art. 71](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng#art_71)      | Opt-out from secondary use                                              | PSS-09                           | 🟡 Consent records in the app and on the patient page; no national opt-out register wired in                                                                                                                                                       |
| [Art. 73(1)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng#073.001)  | SPE security measures, including (e) access logs kept at least one year | IDM-01, OPS-10 to OPS-14, OPS-24 | 🟡 Logs kept 12 months; the SPE is views on the same database, not an isolated environment ([ADR-037](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-037-secure-processing-environment-confidential-computing.md), [ADR-052](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-052-confidential-spe-on-azure-revisited.md)) |
| [Art. 73(3)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng#073.003)  | Regular audits of the SPE, including by third parties                   | All domains                      | ❌ No audit; this analysis is the project's own                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| [Art. 73(5)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/327/oj/eng#073.005)  | Implementing acts on SPE requirements, due by 26 March 2027             | All domains                      | 🔵 To be mapped when adopted                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [GDPR Art. 25](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_25) | Data protection by design and by default                                | IDM-01, PSS-08                   | 🟡                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| [GDPR Art. 32](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng#art_32) | Security of processing                                                  | CRY-02, CRY-03                   | 🟡                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

---

## Changed criterion ids

| Until 2026-03-28         | Now                                                    | Why                                                                     |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| OIS-03 Risk assessment   | OIS-07                                                 | OIS-03 is Interfaces and Dependencies                                   |
| OIS-04 Asset inventory   | AM-01                                                  | OIS-04 is Segregation of Duties                                         |
| OIS-05 Supplier security | SSO-01 to SSO-05                                       | OIS-05 is Contact with Relevant Government Agencies and Interest Groups |
| CCM-01 to CCM-03         | DEV-03, DEV-06, DEV-08                                 | C5:2020 has no CCM domain                                               |
| DEV-02 to DEV-10         | DEV-01, DEV-06, OPS-18, OPS-22, PSS-02, PSS-05         | DEV-02 to DEV-10 have other titles in C5:2020                           |
| IAM-01 to IAM-07         | IDM-01, IDM-02, IDM-06, IDM-09, PSS-05, PSS-06, PSS-08 | C5:2020 has no IAM domain                                               |
| COS-01 to COS-04         | CRY-02, CRY-04, COS-06                                 | COS-01 to COS-04 have other titles in C5:2020                           |
| DIP-01 to DIP-06         | AM-06, CRY-03, OPS-06 to OPS-09, OPS-10, OPS-14        | C5:2020 has no DIP domain                                               |
| LOG-01 to LOG-04         | OPS-10, OPS-12, OPS-13                                 | C5:2020 has no LOG domain                                               |
| INS-01 to INS-03         | SIM-01, SIM-03                                         | C5:2020 has no INS domain                                               |

---

_Last updated: 2026-11-07: criterion ids and titles checked against the C5:2020 PDF, adopted EHDS article numbers, statuses brought up to date. Previous version 2026-03-28, Phase 24, Pentest + API Auth Fix (D6)._

docs.title: Software bills of materials
docs.summary: One CycloneDX bill of materials per deployable part, byte-stable; the --check fails when a bill no longer matches its lockfile.
docs.markdown:
# Software bills of materials

One CycloneDX file per deployable part ([1.7](https://cyclonedx.org/docs/1.7/json/) for the hub and the
three services, [1.5](https://cyclonedx.org/docs/1.5/json/) for the iPhone app, as each file's `specVersion`
says), generated by
[`scripts/security/generate-sbom.sh`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/scripts/security/generate-sbom.sh) ([syft](https://github.com/anchore/syft/releases/tag/v1.51.1) over the lockfiles, no `node_modules`
needed) and committed so a reviewer reads the bill next to the code it
describes. `--check` fails when a committed bill no longer matches the
lockfiles, which is how a dependency change that forgot the bill is caught.

| File                                                       | What                                                                                               | Source of truth                                                                                                 |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`ui.cdx.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/sbom/ui.cdx.json)                               | the Next.js hub, [`ui/`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/tree/main/ui)                                                                 | [`ui/package-lock.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/ui/package-lock.json)                                                            |
| [`neo4j-proxy.cdx.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/sbom/neo4j-proxy.cdx.json)             | the FHIR, OMOP and NLQ bridge                                                                      | [`services/neo4j-proxy/package-lock.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/services/neo4j-proxy/package-lock.json)                        |
| [`epa-ingest.cdx.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/sbom/epa-ingest.cdx.json)               | the ePA ingest CLI and analyte dictionary                                                          | [`services/epa-ingest/package-lock.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/services/epa-ingest/package-lock.json)                          |
| [`claude-federation.cdx.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/sbom/claude-federation.cdx.json) | the hosted explanation service ([ADR-034](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/ADRs/ADR-034-claude-workload-identity-federation.md)) | [`services/claude-federation/package-lock.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/services/claude-federation/package-lock.json)            |
| [`klarbefund-ios.cdx.json`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/docs/sbom/klarbefund-ios.cdx.json)       | the iPhone app, [`clients/ios`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/tree/main/clients/ios)                                                 | [`Package.swift`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/Package.swift), [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/clients/ios/project.yml), the imports |

The iPhone app declares no third-party package, so its bill lists the Apple
frameworks it links (from the `import` statements, by
[`scripts/security/generate-ios-sbom.py`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/scripts/security/generate-ios-sbom.py)) and says so in its metadata. That is
the checkable form of the claim in
[`docs/klarbefund/self-assessment.md`](/docs/security/klarbefund-self-assessment)
(BSI [TR-03161](https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/EN/BSI/Publications/TechGuidelines/TR03161/TR-03161-1.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=2) O.TrdP).

Vulnerabilities against these bills: [`scripts/security/scan-repo.sh`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/scripts/security/scan-repo.sh) runs
[grype](https://github.com/anchore/grype/releases/tag/v0.118.0) over them locally; [`.github/workflows/security-scan.yml`](https://github.com/ma3u/MinimumViableHealthDataspacev2/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scan.yml) does the same
in CI for the hub and uploads the result to the [Security tab](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/code-scanning/introduction-to-code-scanning/about-code-scanning). Container
images are scanned separately, with [trivy](https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/tag/v0.74.0), in the same workflow.
